neighbours.label: ' in' straight after 'one' + noun or 'one of them' (the slot of 'in particular')
fire: One bird in particular kept coming back.
One of the boys in particular made me laugh.
One teacher in that school knew him well.
One house in the row was empty.
One dog in the pack began to howl.
One of the songs in particular stayed with me.
One player in the squad broke his arm.
One flower in the garden is still in bloom.
quiet: The third bird in the flock kept coming back.
Some of the boys in the class made me laugh.
The teacher in that school knew him well.
A house in the row was empty.
The dog in the pack began to howl.
Most of the songs in the album stayed with me.
A player in the squad broke his arm.
The flower in the garden is still in bloom.

notes: The pole fires before the next word is seen, so 'One star in the sky' and 'One star in particular' read the same in a probe (0.642). The card's ' A' of 'FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE' is not covered.
